fact: The Governor launched the Eswatini Payment Switch Fast Payments module on 11 December 2024 with three participants live (Eswatini Bank, Swaziland Building Society, E-mali), participation mandated for all payment service providers offering local payments, interoperable between banks and non-banks.
title: Eswatini Payment Switch Fast Payments product launch
publisher: Bank for International Settlements (speech by Phil Mnisi, Central Bank of Eswatini)
